dek: Lebanese media report an Israeli drone strike targeting a motorcycle in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, killing one person and injuring another (preliminary reports). Lebanese health authorities have not commented; the IDF has not commented.
sources: Lebanese media (NBN Lebanon post on X, Nov 4) via Times of Israel liveblog
fault_line: Another ceasefire violation killing in the south vs. a routine targeted strike whose target is still unnamed

sections.what_happened: Lebanese media report an Israeli drone strike targeting a motorcycle in Qabrikha, southern Lebanon, killing one person and injuring another (preliminary reports). Lebanese health authorities have not commented; the IDF has not commented. Target identity (fighter vs civilian) is unstated in the report.
sections.what_verified: 1 countable family: Times of Israel (T3). NBN Lebanon has NO declared tier in the registry and does not count toward corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: No confirmation from Lebanon's Health Ministry or the IDF; no second outlet independently reported the strike in-window. Pattern context cuts both ways: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon are near-daily (AJ day-66 item 11:46Z listed 8 locations struck), but single-casualty motorcycle strikes are routinely first reported by local media and sometimes revised.
sections.why_matters: Not a standalone Short: single preliminary casualty, unconfirmed, target unnamed. Monitor only; usable only as a line inside a Lebanon-pattern Short if health-authority or IDF confirmation lands. Do NOT use the re-dated edgeone 'at least 12 killed' article (13:51Z mirror stamp, Friday/Thursday events) as corroboration — same re-date trap flagged at 0600-06.
